action.code: const tempSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.max >= 2000); if(tempSlider) { tempSlider.value = 1200; tempSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); } const pressSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.max <= 100 && s.max >= 50); if(pressSlider) { pressSlider.value = 25; pressSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

postconditions: Temperature adjusted to mid-range value around 1200K
Pressure adjusted to mid-range value around 25atm
Specimen material properties changed (clearcoat, roughness, or metalness)

action.code: for(let i=0; i<4; i++) { const sel = document.querySelector('select'); if(sel) sel.selectedIndex = (i%5)+1; const tempSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.max >= 2000); if(tempSlider) { tempSlider.value = 500 + i*300; tempSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); } const reactBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.match(/react/i)); if(reactBtn) reactBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); }

postconditions: Mass conservation maintained across all reactions

action.code: for(let i=0; i<6; i++) { const sel = document.querySelector('select'); if(sel) sel.selectedIndex = (i%5)+1; const tempSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.max >= 2000); if(tempSlider) { tempSlider.value = 1000 + i*150; tempSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); } const pressSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.max <= 100 && s.max >= 50); if(pressSlider) { pressSlider.value = 10 + i*5; pressSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); } const reactBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.match(/react/i)); if(reactBtn) reactBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); }

postconditions: Temperature and pressure varied across wide ranges
All five reagents used at least once
Specimen fully transformed with complex material properties
